source: docs/question_inventory.md Part D. These are the only forms the prober may use. At most three per domain, one at a time, to that person only, reason attached, skip allowed.

templates.text: You answered X here and Y in [domain]. Help me understand how those fit together.
templates.pattern: ^You answered .+ here and .+ in .+\. Help me understand how those fit together\.$

templates.text: Your [score] suggests [pattern], and here you said [the opposite]. How do those fit for you?
templates.pattern: ^Your .+ suggests .+, and here you said .+\. How do those fit for you\?$

templates.text: You rated yourself high on [behavior], and your scenario answers here are mostly about [contrasting behavior]. Help me see how those fit.
templates.pattern: ^You rated yourself high on .+, and your scenario answers here are mostly about .+\. Help me see how those fit\.$

templates.text: What would it look like if your partner did the thing you said you'd do?
templates.pattern: ^What would it look like if your partner did the thing you said you'd do\?$

templates.text: Is this a preference or a requirement?
templates.pattern: ^Is this a preference or a requirement\?$

parenting_watch_for: high self-rated warmth with scenario answers that are all control
respect defined as obedience alongside adult conduct the person wouldn't accept from the child
an easygoing self-description with no structure the person can name
